description: Opens of one of your pages (GET /api/u/:user/:slug/views): total, today, identified readers (signed-in readers, or 'link:<recipient>' for links with a recipient) and the first external open (firstViewedAt, firstViewer). Team members' views are not counted. Works with any key that can read the page. Read-only.

slug.description: Page slug/path; hierarchical paths are allowed (e.g. 'briefings/today')

user.description: Page owner namespace (default: the connected account; a company key reads its org)

name: outbox_page_views
title: Outbox: who opened a page
